name: Pochi
source:
"I'm Pochi, and, uh, I like karaoke and going for walks. That and my master, even though I cause him worry sometimes. I hope you like me!"

This happy and energetic puppy girl has a big adventure when she gets separated from her master and tries to find her own way home.
